Job Description Summary 
At GE HealthCare, we develop digital solutions that empower healthcare professionals to deliver better patient care. We are looking for a passionate and customer-focused Software Engineer – Medical Applications (Ultrasound) to join our ViewPoint team and help shape the next generation of ultrasound reporting and workflow solutions.

You will work at the intersection of healthcare and technology, collaborating with product owners, product managers, UX designers, clinicians, and fellow software engineers to build intuitive, scalable, and clinically meaningful applications. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute directly to software that supports patient diagnosis and care across specialties such as Obstetrics, Gynecology, Cardiovascular, and Gastrointestinal imaging. 
 
 
 
 Job Description 
 What You'll Do 
 Design, develop, and maintain software solutions supporting ultrasound reporting and clinical workflows.
 Develop and integrate structured medical reporting solutions using TypeScript, XML, JSON, and SQL databases.
 Collaborate with product owners, clinicians, and domain experts to understand user needs, define requirements, and translate them into high-quality technical solutions.
 Partner with UX designers to create intuitive and efficient user experiences.
 Explore, evaluate, and apply emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), to enhance product capabilities, improve user experiences, and accelerate innovation and the development process.
 Participate in agile development activities including sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
 Contribute to software quality through automated testing, peer reviews, and continuous integration practices.
 Support interoperability and integration with healthcare IT ecosystems.
 Help drive innovation in digital ultrasound workflows and reporting solutions.
 Required Qualifications 
 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Computing, Medical Engineering, or an equivalent university degree

 You have a strong software engineering background with a deep interest in clinical workflows, or you come with a clinical background and want to advance into building software solutions
 Professional software engineering experience (medior level), ideally in medical software
 Experience in agile software development, processes and tools (e.g. Bitbucket/GitHub, JIRA)
 Professional experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, XML, JSON, and SQL
 Experience in using AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar AI-assisted development tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and workflows in software development
 Collaborative team player and open to continuous development
 Mindset of innovation and continuous improvement
 Professional-level English communication skills
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Understanding of clinical workflows and medical terminology and ideally SNOMED CT
 Experience with Java, C++, Angular, NestJS, REST APIs, and modern web application architecture
 Knowledge of ultrasound imaging, reporting, and workflows in OB, GYN, cardiovascular, or gastrointestinal ultrasound
 Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards and healthcare information systems such as FHIR, HL7, and DICOM
 
 Why This Role Matters 
 Our solutions are used by healthcare professionals worldwide to improve clinical efficiency and patient care. As a Software Engineer in our team, you will have the opportunity to influence products that make a real difference in everyday clinical practice while working alongside experienced engineering, product owners, UX, product management, and clinical experts.

 Additional Information
